summary: CWE-397 is triggered because bad() declares and throws the generic java.lang.Exception, forcing callers to handle an overly broad type. The fix replaces it with a specific exception type (FileNotFoundException, already imported and used by good()), preserving the behavior of throwing/propagating an exception while narrowing the declared and thrown type. The overriding of the abstract bad() (which declares throws Throwable) remains valid.
